from visits import load_visits, ROWS
from spans import minutes_between


def test_three_positions():
    data = list(load_visits())
    assert minutes_between(data, 2, 4) == [v for _, v in ROWS[1:4]]


def test_low_above_high():
    data = list(load_visits())
    assert minutes_between(data, 3, 2) == []
